nodes.label: The Talisman
nodes.description: A boy’s search for a way to save his mother takes him across America and into the parallel world of the Territories.

nodes.label: Black House
nodes.description: Years after The Talisman, Jack Sawyer has left police work behind. A murder investigation in Wisconsin draws him back into danger.

nodes.label: Carrie
nodes.description: Carrie White is an isolated teenager caught between a strict home life and relentless school bullying. As she discovers an extraordinary ability to move things with her mind, her longing to belong becomes increasingly dangerous.

nodes.label: 'Salem's Lot
nodes.description: Writer Ben Mears returns to his childhood town, hoping to work through the memories of a house that still troubles him. Familiar streets become threatening as a new evil spreads through the community.

nodes.label: The Shining
nodes.description: Jack Torrance takes a winter job at the remote Overlook Hotel, bringing his wife Wendy and their son Danny. Snowbound isolation and Danny’s unusual perceptions turn the family’s hoped-for fresh start into an encounter with the hotel’s dark past.

nodes.label: Rage
nodes.description: A high-school student holds a classroom hostage through a tense afternoon of confrontation. The novel explores anger and coercion; King has asked that it receive no further printings.

nodes.label: The Stand
nodes.description: A devastating epidemic leaves scattered survivors trying to rebuild their lives and find one another. Their search for community becomes a struggle over what kind of world should rise from the ruins.

nodes.label: The Long Walk
nodes.description: One hundred teenage boys take part in a walking contest in an authoritarian America, where falling behind carries fatal consequences. Endurance, fear and friendship shape a competition that promises everything to its sole winner.

nodes.label: The Dead Zone
nodes.description: Johnny Smith wakes from a long coma with the ability to glimpse other people’s pasts and futures through touch. Trying to rebuild his interrupted life, he faces a troubling question: what responsibility comes with knowing what may happen?

nodes.label: Firestarter
nodes.description: Young Charlie McGee can start fires with her mind, an ability that makes her a target for a secret government organisation. Her father tries to keep her safe as their pursuers seek to turn her gift into a weapon.

nodes.label: Roadwork
nodes.description: A highway development threatens both Barton Dawes’s home and his working life. His refusal to surrender what he has built grows into an increasingly desperate confrontation with the forces reshaping his world.

nodes.label: Cujo
nodes.description: A beloved St Bernard becomes a threat after contracting rabies. When Donna Trenton and her young son arrive at an isolated garage, an ordinary errand becomes a struggle against heat, confinement and a dangerously changed animal.

nodes.label: The Running Man
nodes.description: Desperate to pay for his daughter’s medical care, Ben Richards enters a televised competition that makes him the target of a nationwide hunt. Survival depends on staying ahead of the pursuers and a public encouraged to betray him.

nodes.label: The Dark Tower: The Gunslinger
nodes.description: Roland Deschain crosses a harsh, fading world in pursuit of an elusive man in black. The opening volume introduces a lone gunslinger whose search points towards the mysterious Dark Tower.
alternatives: The Dark Tower I: The Gunslinger

nodes.label: Christine
nodes.description: Teenager Arnie Cunningham becomes devoted to restoring a battered 1958 Plymouth Fury. As the car takes a stronger hold on his life, the people close to him begin to fear that his prized possession has a will of its own.

nodes.label: Pet Sematary
nodes.description: Louis Creed and his family settle into a new home in rural Maine, close to a busy road and a children’s pet cemetery. Beyond the familiar burial ground lies a deeper temptation, drawing the story into grief and the fear of letting go.

nodes.label: Cycle of the Werewolf
nodes.description: A werewolf brings recurring terror to the small town of Tarker’s Mills, while a young boy begins to suspect the truth. Moving through the months of a year, the story turns a familiar community into a place governed by fear of the next full moon.

nodes.label: Thinner
nodes.description: After a fatal road accident, a well-connected lawyer avoids serious punishment but begins losing weight at an impossible rate. His search for an explanation becomes a confrontation with guilt, revenge and the price of escaping responsibility.

nodes.label: IT
nodes.description: A group of childhood friends is drawn back to Derry by a danger they thought they had left behind. Moving between childhood and adulthood, the novel explores the bonds that sustain them and the fears hidden beneath their town’s ordinary surface.

nodes.label: The Eyes of the Dragon
nodes.description: In the kingdom of Delain, a prince is imprisoned after being accused of his father’s murder. Court intrigue, loyal friends and a dangerous magician shape a fairy-tale struggle over the future of the kingdom.

nodes.label: Misery
nodes.description: After a car accident, novelist Paul Sheldon wakes in the care of Annie Wilkes, an intensely devoted reader. Her attachment to his fiction turns recovery into captivity, forcing him to confront the power a reader can hold over a storyteller.

nodes.label: The Dark Tower: The Drawing of the Three
nodes.description: On a remote shore, Roland encounters doors that connect his world to the lives of people in New York. The second volume brings new companions and conflicting needs into the gunslinger’s quest.
alternatives: The Dark Tower II: The Drawing of the Three

nodes.label: The Tommyknockers
nodes.description: Writer Bobbi Anderson discovers something metallic buried in the woods near her home. Her growing obsession with uncovering it accompanies unsettling changes in the town of Haven, where remarkable new abilities come at a troubling cost.

nodes.label: The Dark Half
nodes.description: Writer Thad Beaumont publicly retires the pseudonym behind his successful crime novels. A series of violent crimes then threatens his family and reputation, blurring the boundary between an invented author and the man who created him.

nodes.label: The Dark Tower: The Waste Lands
nodes.description: Roland and his companions follow the Path of the Beam across a world of ruins and unfamiliar dangers. The third volume expands their journey through Mid-World as the group learns to face its challenges together.
alternatives: The Dark Tower III: The Waste Lands

nodes.label: Needful Things
nodes.description: A new shop in Castle Rock seems to offer every customer the object they most desire. Its proprietor asks for small favours alongside payment, quietly turning personal wishes and old resentments against the town.

nodes.label: Gerald's Game
nodes.description: A woman left handcuffed to a bed in an isolated house must find a way to survive. With no easy route to help, fear and memory become as immediate as the physical danger.

nodes.label: Dolores Claiborne
nodes.description: Suspected of killing her employer, Dolores Claiborne tells the police about her working life, her marriage and the events that still shape her island community. Her account becomes an intimate examination of loyalty, abuse and the choices made under pressure.

nodes.label: Insomnia
nodes.description: An older widower in Derry finds himself waking earlier each night until ordinary sleep almost disappears. Strange sights around the town lead him to wonder whether exhaustion is distorting reality or revealing another side of it.

nodes.label: Rose Madder
nodes.description: Rosie Daniels escapes an abusive marriage and begins building a new life in another city. A painting she finds offers a strange attraction, while the husband she left uses his police connections to pursue her.

nodes.label: The Green Mile
nodes.description: Prison officer Paul Edgecomb looks back on an extraordinary inmate who arrived on death row in the 1930s. Originally told in six serial instalments, the novel examines punishment, compassion and the limits of human judgement.

nodes.label: Desperation
nodes.description: A group of travellers is trapped in a remote Nevada mining town under the control of a terrifying lawman. Their search for escape brings them up against an older danger tied to the town’s past.

nodes.label: The Regulators
nodes.description: An ordinary suburban afternoon collapses into terror when armed strangers descend on a quiet Ohio street. As the surroundings themselves begin to change, the trapped neighbours face a reality that no longer follows familiar rules.

nodes.label: The Dark Tower: Wizard and Glass
nodes.description: As the quest continues, Roland looks back to the events that shaped him as a young gunslinger. Love, loyalty and the pressures of an earlier world lie at the centre of this story within the larger journey.
alternatives: The Dark Tower IV: Wizard and Glass

nodes.label: Bag of Bones
nodes.description: Widowed novelist Mike Noonan returns to his lakeside home in Maine, hoping to recover the ability to write. A custody dispute and disturbing events at the house draw him into secrets that connect grief in the present with an unsettled past.

nodes.label: The Girl Who Loved Tom Gordon
nodes.description: Nine-year-old Trisha becomes lost during a family hike and must rely on her ingenuity to survive in the woods. Radio broadcasts of her favourite baseball team offer comfort as isolation and the possibility of something following her deepen her fear.
alternatives: Het meisje dat hield van Tom Gordon

nodes.label: Dreamcatcher
nodes.description: Four childhood friends reunite for their annual hunting trip in the Maine woods. The arrival of a confused stranger turns the visit into a struggle with an otherworldly threat, bringing the bonds and secrets of their shared past back into focus.

nodes.label: From a Buick 8
nodes.description: Pennsylvania state troopers have spent years keeping an abandoned Buick hidden behind their barracks. As they recount its unsettling history, the car becomes the focus of a story about loss and the desire for answers.

nodes.label: The Dark Tower: Wolves of the Calla
nodes.description: A farming community asks Roland and his companions for protection from the riders who threaten its children. The fifth volume brings the gunslingers into a town whose immediate danger is tied to the wider struggle for the Tower.
alternatives: The Dark Tower V: Wolves of the Calla

nodes.label: The Dark Tower: Song of Susannah
nodes.description: The sixth volume divides the quest between different places and times, with Susannah at the centre of a growing crisis. The companions face dangers on more than one front as the protection of the Tower becomes increasingly urgent.
alternatives: The Dark Tower VI: Song of Susannah

nodes.label: The Dark Tower
nodes.description: The seventh volume carries Roland’s long quest into its final stage. The journey draws together threads from the saga and the wider King universe while asking what the Tower and its pursuit have demanded.

nodes.label: The Colorado Kid
nodes.description: Two veteran newspapermen tell their young colleague about an unidentified man found dead on a Maine island. Following the clues becomes a conversation about evidence, storytelling and the drive to make sense of an unexplained death.

nodes.label: Cell
nodes.description: A mysterious signal turns mobile-phone users violently against the people around them. Artist Clay Riddell joins other survivors on a journey towards his family as familiar society collapses and the changed population begins to behave in unexpected ways.

nodes.label: Lisey's Story
nodes.description: Lisey Landon begins sorting the papers of her late husband, a celebrated novelist. Threats over his unpublished work and memories of their marriage draw her towards the private world he kept close, testing the strength she has yet to recognise in herself.

nodes.label: Blaze
nodes.description: A small-time criminal attempts to kidnap a wealthy family’s baby, guided by memories of his former partner. His growing attachment to the child brings the damage of his own upbringing into a crime story about vulnerability and choice.

nodes.label: Duma Key
nodes.description: After a devastating accident, Edgar Freemantle moves to the Florida coast and begins painting as part of rebuilding his life. His new talent and friendships lead him towards the island’s history, where creativity and danger become closely entwined.

nodes.label: Under the Dome
nodes.description: Chester’s Mill is suddenly sealed off by an invisible barrier, separating families and cutting the town off from outside help. Residents try to understand what has happened while competing ideas of leadership turn the emergency into a struggle for control.

English teacher Jake Epping discovers a passage into 1958 and takes on a mission to prevent President Kennedy’s assassination. Building a life in another era proves as complicated as changing history, especially when the past resists interference.

nodes.label: The Dark Tower: The Wind Through the Keyhole
nodes.description: While sheltering from a dangerous storm, Roland tells his companions stories from his younger days. An investigation and a fairy tale unfold within that frame, adding another perspective on Mid-World and the power of storytelling.

nodes.label: Joyland
nodes.description: College student Devin Jones takes a summer job at an amusement park after a broken romance. New friendships and the unsolved murder associated with the park’s haunted attraction draw him into a coming-of-age story shaped by mystery, love and loss.

nodes.label: Doctor Sleep
nodes.description: Dan Torrance is trying to build a steadier life when he meets a girl with an unusually strong psychic gift. Their connection draws him into danger from a travelling group that seeks out children with the shining.

nodes.label: Mr. Mercedes
nodes.description: An attack on a crowd waiting for a job fair leaves an unknown driver at large. The opening Bill Hodges novel turns that unresolved crime into a tense pursuit between a determined investigator and a calculating killer.

nodes.label: Revival
nodes.description: A musician’s life repeatedly intersects with that of a charismatic minister whose beliefs have been shattered by loss. Their shared history draws them towards an obsessive search for answers about life, death and what might lie beyond.

nodes.label: Finders Keepers
nodes.description: A reader’s obsession with a reclusive novelist leaves a hidden cache of unpublished writing. When a boy discovers it years later, Bill Hodges and his partners are drawn into a dangerous struggle over who controls the stories.

nodes.label: End of Watch
nodes.description: Bill Hodges and Holly Gibney investigate a disturbing case connected to the Mercedes massacre. The final novel of the Hodges trilogy brings their detective work into contact with a threat that challenges ordinary explanations.

nodes.label: Sleeping Beauties
nodes.description: Women around the world become enclosed in strange coverings when they fall asleep, leaving their communities in crisis. Written with Owen King, the novel centres on an Appalachian town where fear and division gather around one apparently unaffected woman.

nodes.label: Gwendy's Button Box
nodes.description: A stranger entrusts twelve-year-old Gwendy Peterson with a mysterious box during a summer in Castle Rock. Its rewards and dangerous possibilities turn a childhood encounter into a test of temptation and responsibility.

nodes.label: The Outsider
nodes.description: A child’s murder seems to point unmistakably towards a respected local man, until the evidence begins to contradict itself. Detective Ralph Anderson must question an apparently solid case as the investigation moves beyond familiar explanations.

nodes.label: Elevation
nodes.description: A Castle Rock man finds his weight dropping even though his body does not change. His attempts to understand the condition and help neighbours facing prejudice turn the mystery into a story about finding common ground.

nodes.label: The Institute
nodes.description: Luke Ellis wakes in a sinister facility where other children also possess unusual mental abilities. As the staff push those abilities to their limits, friendship and the hope of escape become his means of resistance.

nodes.label: Later
nodes.description: Jamie Conklin’s unusual ability brings him into contact with the dead. Drawn into a detective’s pursuit of a dangerous killer, he discovers that using the gift can carry a personal cost.

nodes.label: Billy Summers
nodes.description: A professional killer with a strict personal code accepts one last assignment before retiring. His attempt to leave violence behind becomes a story of luck, trust and the possibility of redemption.

nodes.label: Gwendy's Final Task
nodes.description: Gwendy Peterson must keep the dangerous button box away from forces determined to possess it. Stephen King and Richard Chizmar bring the trilogy to its final mission, taking Gwendy’s responsibility far beyond Castle Rock.

nodes.label: Fairy Tale
nodes.description: Teenager Charlie Reade befriends an elderly neighbour and his dog, Radar, before discovering a way into another world. The bond leads him into a fantasy adventure where the dangers of that realm reach towards his own.

nodes.label: Holly
nodes.description: A mother asks Holly Gibney to find her missing daughter, drawing the investigator into a series of disappearances. Careful observation and persistence become essential as Holly looks beneath an outwardly respectable community.

nodes.label: Never Flinch
nodes.description: Holly Gibney is asked to help with a threatening letter while protecting a touring women’s rights activist from an increasingly bold stalker. Two strands of suspense follow the escalating danger around the people she is trying to help.

nodes.label: Other Worlds Than These
nodes.description: An older Jack Sawyer faces threats spreading between America and the other worlds he has travelled. The third Talisman novel brings the series’ long journey into a struggle whose stakes extend beyond a single world.

nodes.label: Blockade Billy
nodes.description: A brilliant baseball player has been deliberately erased from the record books. The story looks behind the legend of William ‘Blockade Billy’ Blakely to uncover the secret that made his exceptional talent impossible to celebrate.

nodes.label: American Vampire
nodes.description: The opening five-issue arc of this vampire comic pairs a story by Scott Snyder with a separate storyline by Stephen King, illustrated by Rafael Albuquerque. It introduces a distinct strain of vampire against an American setting.

nodes.label: Faithful
nodes.description: Stephen King and Stewart O’Nan follow the Boston Red Sox through the 2004 season in game observations and correspondence. Their shared perspective as supporters captures the anxieties, rituals and excitement of following a team together.

nodes.label: Nightmares in the Sky
nodes.description: Photographs of gargoyles and Gothic architectural details by f-stop Fitzgerald are accompanied by a text from Stephen King. The book explores the unsettling figures that watch over everyday city life.
alternatives: Nightmares in the Sky: Gargoyles and Grotesques

nodes.label: Jerusalem's Lot
nodes.description: An epistolary tale told through correspondence between two friends. Collected in Night Shift, Jerusalem's Lot also provided the starting point for the television series Chapelwaite.

nodes.label: Graveyard Shift
nodes.description: A mill’s cleanup crew faces an infestation of rats in this workplace horror story from Night Shift.

nodes.label: Night Surf
nodes.description: A devastating virus threatens humanity in this early apocalyptic story from Night Shift.

nodes.label: I Am the Doorway
nodes.description: Arthur and Cory take part in a mission to Venus, giving this Night Shift story its space-travel setting. It also appears in the anthology Thrilling, Chilling Tales of Alien Encounters.

nodes.label: The Mangler
nodes.description: A detective investigates a fatal accident at an industrial laundry. The machine involved seems to have defeated its own safety measures, making an ordinary workplace increasingly difficult to explain.

nodes.label: The Boogeyman
nodes.description: A father visits a psychiatrist to explain the deaths of his children and the terror he believes followed his family. A childhood fear becomes the centre of a deeply unsettling conversation.

nodes.label: Grey Matter
nodes.description: A reclusive drinker begins a disturbing transformation in this tale of bodily horror from Night Shift.

nodes.label: Battleground
nodes.description: After killing a toymaker, a professional hitman becomes the target of an extraordinary counterattack. His latest assignment turns into a battle against a very unexpected enemy.

nodes.label: Trucks
nodes.description: Travellers shelter in a roadside diner while driverless trucks gather outside. Familiar machines have turned against their owners, leaving the people inside to decide how to survive.

nodes.label: Sometimes They Come Back
nodes.description: Teacher Jim Norman hopes his new job will offer a fresh start. Then a face from a violent childhood memory appears in his classroom, making the past frighteningly hard to leave behind.

nodes.label: Strawberry Spring
nodes.description: An unusually warm spell brings fog to a New England college campus. Years later, a former student recalls the fear and rumours that surrounded a series of murders during that strange spring.

nodes.label: The Ledge
nodes.description: Stan Norris falls into the hands of a wealthy man with a taste for cruel wagers. A narrow ledge high above the street becomes the setting for a terrifying test of nerve.

nodes.label: The Lawnmower Man
nodes.description: An ordinary lawnmower becomes an instrument of evil in this unsettling story from Night Shift.

nodes.label: Quitters, Inc.
nodes.description: A smoker willing to try anything to quit finds a disturbing answer in this story from Night Shift.

nodes.label: I Know What You Need
nodes.description: College student Elizabeth Rogan meets a young man who seems to know exactly what would help her. His uncanny attentiveness raises an uncomfortable question about the difference between understanding someone and controlling them.

nodes.label: Children of the Corn
nodes.description: A couple travelling through Nebraska reaches an isolated community after a road accident. The town’s children and their beliefs turn the stop into something far more disturbing than a detour.

nodes.label: The Last Rung on the Ladder
nodes.description: A man revisits a childhood memory of climbing a dangerous barn ladder with his sister. The story explores trust, family bonds and the distance that can grow between adults.

nodes.label: The Man Who Loved Flowers
nodes.description: A young man walks through New York on a pleasant evening and stops to buy flowers. What looks like an ordinary romantic errand becomes a brief, unsettling portrait of appearances.

nodes.label: One for the Road
nodes.description: During a fierce snowstorm, a stranded traveller asks two Maine locals to help his family. The rescue leads toward a place they would rather avoid.

nodes.label: The Woman in the Room
nodes.description: Johnny watches his seriously ill mother suffer and struggles with what compassion requires. A quiet, painful story about family, helplessness and the moral weight of care.

nodes.label: Rita Hayworth and Shawshank Redemption
nodes.description: Andy Dufresne is a prisoner at Shawshank, where Red is a fellow inmate. This story from Different Seasons follows life behind bars in a tale of unjust imprisonment.

nodes.label: Apt Pupil
nodes.description: A California schoolboy discovers that an elderly neighbour has a terrible past. His fascination draws the two into a disturbing relationship, as curiosity becomes a form of power.

nodes.label: The Body
nodes.description: Four boys leave their Maine town to search the woods for the body of a missing child. Their journey brings friendship, fear and the uncertainties of growing up into sharp focus.

nodes.label: The Breathing Method
nodes.description: In an unusual private club, a doctor tells the other members about a determined pregnant woman. A quiet storytelling evening becomes a tale of childbirth and the uncanny.

nodes.label: The Mist
nodes.description: After a violent storm, David Drayton and his son Billy join other shoppers at a grocery store. A strange mist traps them inside, while creatures outside and growing fear within threaten the group.

nodes.label: Here There Be Tygers
nodes.description: For a schoolboy named Charles, the bathroom hides a terrifying tiger. An ordinary school day becomes a child’s nightmare in this early story.

nodes.label: The Monkey
nodes.description: A sinister toy monkey stands at the centre of this story about Hal Shelburn and his family. Something meant for a child carries a much darker presence.

nodes.label: Cain Rose Up
nodes.description: College student Curt Garrish turns his dormitory room into the position for a shooting attack. This short story brings horror into the familiar setting of a university campus.

nodes.label: Mrs. Todd's Shortcut
nodes.description: Mrs. Todd’s talent for finding shortcuts promises more than an ordinary drive. Her journeys turn the search for a shorter route into something stranger.

nodes.label: The Jaunt
nodes.description: A device known as the Jaunt makes teleportation possible. This technological advance provides the background to a science-fiction story narrated by Mark Oates.

nodes.label: The Wedding Gig
nodes.description: Jazz musicians and the world of small-time racketeering meet at Maureen Scollay’s wedding. The celebration brings a band and a troubled family into the same room.

nodes.label: Paranoid: A Chant
nodes.description: A voice records the threats it sees in ordinary encounters, meals and neighbours. This poem creates an increasingly claustrophobic portrait of a mind convinced that danger is everywhere.

nodes.label: The Raft
nodes.description: Four students swim out to a raft on an isolated lake for a final autumn outing. A strange dark patch on the water makes the short journey back to shore suddenly look very different.

nodes.label: Word Processor of the Gods
nodes.description: Writer and teacher Richard Hagstrom receives a word processor built by his nephew Jonathan. The unusual homemade gift becomes the centre of this tale.

nodes.label: The Man Who Would Not Shake Hands
nodes.description: At a private club, a man recalls a card player who recoiled from even the simplest physical contact. An impulsive handshake turns an odd social habit into a troubling mystery.

nodes.label: Beachworld
nodes.description: Two survivors of a spacecraft crash find themselves on a world of seemingly endless sand. While one hopes for rescue, the other begins to feel a dangerous attraction to the dunes.

nodes.label: The Reaper's Image
nodes.description: An antique collector visits a museum to inspect a rare mirror. Its curator has a disturbing history to share, and the visitor’s scepticism is tested by what the glass may reveal.

nodes.label: Nona
nodes.description: A young drifter travelling through Maine meets a woman named Nona on a winter night. His account of their encounter blurs attraction, violence and the question of how much his memories can be trusted.

nodes.label: For Owen
nodes.description: On a walk to school, a father listens to his son imagine a school populated by fruit. This short poem captures the playful invention of childhood in an ordinary family moment.

nodes.label: Survivor Type
nodes.description: A disgraced surgeon keeps a diary after a shipwreck leaves him stranded on a small island. With little to eat and no obvious rescue, his determination to survive becomes an increasingly disturbing test.

nodes.label: Uncle Otto's Truck
nodes.description: A nephew recounts his uncle’s growing fixation on a derelict truck. Otto insists the abandoned vehicle is moving and means him harm, leaving the storyteller to weigh obsession against something more frightening.

nodes.label: Morning Deliveries (Milkman #1)
nodes.description: Milkman Spike Milligan makes his morning rounds, but his customers’ deliveries contain more than they expect. A brief story transforms a familiar neighbourhood routine into a source of menace.

nodes.label: Big Wheels: A Tale of the Laundry Game (Milkman #2)
nodes.description: After a shift at the laundry, Rocky and Leo drive around drinking and searching for a garage that will inspect Rocky’s car before midnight. Their apparently aimless evening takes an increasingly uneasy turn.

nodes.label: Gramma
nodes.description: A boy is left alone with his grandmother, and the familiar family home becomes a source of fear. An ordinary family responsibility takes on a frightening weight.

nodes.label: The Ballad of the Flexible Bullet
nodes.description: A magazine editor receives a remarkable story from a novelist and begins corresponding with him. As the writer shares his strange beliefs about creativity, the editor finds himself drawn into an unstable private world.

nodes.label: The Reach
nodes.description: Ninety-five-year-old Stella Flanders has spent her whole life on Goat Island without crossing to the mainland. As she grows frailer, memories of her island community make the water beyond home take on new meaning.

nodes.label: The Langoliers
nodes.description: Passengers waking on an overnight flight to Maine discover that most of the people aboard have vanished, including the crew. Those who remain must confront an impossible situation in an aircraft that is still flying.

nodes.label: Secret Window, Secret Garden
nodes.description: Writer Mort Rainey is struggling through a divorce when a stranger accuses him of plagiarism. His efforts to defend his story become increasingly unsettling as the evidence he needs begins to disappear.

nodes.label: The Library Policeman
nodes.description: Books borrowed for a speech become the beginning of a nightmare when they are not returned. An everyday library visit draws a man into a frightening encounter with the authority behind its rules.

nodes.label: The Sun Dog
nodes.description: A boy’s birthday Polaroid camera refuses to photograph the world in front of it. Instead, every picture shows the same threatening dog, apparently moving closer with each new shot.

nodes.label: Dolan's Cadillac
nodes.description: After crime boss Jimmy Dolan kills a witness, her husband devotes years to planning revenge. Grief and obsession drive a contest between a powerful criminal and a patient adversary.

nodes.label: The End of the Whole Mess
nodes.description: Howard Forney records the story of his brilliant younger brother Bobby, whose discovery promises to reduce aggression. A plan to bring peace to the world tests the distance between a hopeful idea and its consequences.

nodes.label: Suffer the Little Children
nodes.description: An unsettling remark from a pupil disturbs elderly teacher Miss Sidley. Her growing suspicions about the children at Summer Street School turn the classroom into a place of fear and uncertainty.

nodes.label: The Night Flier
nodes.description: Tabloid reporter Richard Dees investigates a string of murders linked to small airports and a mysterious pilot. Chasing a sensational story takes him toward a subject that may resist his usual cynicism.

nodes.label: Popsy
nodes.description: A gambler trying to pay off dangerous debts abducts a lost-looking child from a shopping centre. The boy keeps insisting that his grandfather, whom he calls Popsy, will come for him.

nodes.label: It Grows on You
nodes.description: The history of a notorious Castle Rock house emerges through local memories and strange events. As new sections appear on the building, its growth becomes entangled with the town’s darker stories.

nodes.label: Chattery Teeth
nodes.description: Salesman Bill Hogan receives a supposedly broken novelty toy from a convenience-store clerk. The strange metal teeth accompany him on a journey that gives an ordinary roadside purchase an unsettling significance.

nodes.label: Dedication
nodes.description: A hotel maid hopes to secure a gifted future for her unborn son by drawing on the talent of a writer who stays there. Her turn to magic connects a mother's ambition with the life of an eccentric guest.

nodes.label: The Moving Finger
nodes.description: Howard Mitla discovers a human finger protruding from the drain in his bathroom sink. An impossible intrusion into his apartment becomes an increasingly urgent problem, shadowed by the question of what might be below it.

nodes.label: Sneakers
nodes.description: Working at a recording studio, John Tell repeatedly notices the same dirty sneakers in the bathroom. Curiosity about their presence draws him towards a mystery behind the studio's everyday routines.

nodes.label: You Know They Got a Hell of a Band
nodes.description: A couple taking a scenic drive through Oregon lose their way and discover a picture-perfect small town. Its nostalgic charm and musical atmosphere begin to feel a little too carefully arranged.

nodes.label: Home Delivery
nodes.description: Pregnant widow Maddie Pace is already facing life without her fisherman husband when the dead begin attacking the living. A wider catastrophe brings a new kind of threat into the midst of her bereavement.

nodes.label: Rainy Season
nodes.description: A couple arrives in Willow, Maine, and stays despite warnings from local residents. The approach of the rainy season gives those warnings a threatening significance in a story about outsiders and a community's secrets.

nodes.label: My Pretty Pony
nodes.description: An elderly man gives his grandson a pocket watch and advice about the passing of time. Their conversation turns a small inheritance into a meditation on attention, memory and the fleeting nature of experience.

nodes.label: Sorry, Right Number
nodes.description: Katie receives a broken, desperate telephone call and fears that someone in her family needs help. This screenplay turns an ordinary evening and an unidentified voice into a growing mystery.

nodes.label: The Ten O'Clock People
nodes.description: A smoker’s break from work gives him a glimpse of something impossible. Others who share his habit may be the only people who understand what he has seen.

nodes.label: Crouch End
nodes.description: Doris Freeman reports her husband's disappearance with a disturbing account of what happened in Crouch End. Two officers weigh her story differently, setting ordinary police work against the possibility of something profoundly strange.

nodes.label: The House on Maple Street
nodes.description: The four Bradbury children discover metal and machinery appearing within the structure of their home. The transformation gives them a mystery to investigate while fear of their stepfather adds another pressure inside the house.

nodes.label: The Fifth Quarter
nodes.description: A criminal pursues the men who betrayed his friend after an armoured-car robbery. Pieces of a divided map point toward the stolen money, turning revenge into a dangerous search.

nodes.label: The Doctor's Case
nodes.description: Sherlock Holmes and Dr. Watson investigate the murder of Lord Hull, with his wife and three sons among the suspects. King enters the world of the consulting detective through a mystery centred on an unhappy household.

nodes.label: Umney's Last Case
nodes.description: A new client interrupts private investigator Clyde Umney's apparently ordinary day in 1930s Los Angeles. The encounter starts to unsettle the foundations of his familiar world in a story that plays with the conventions of detective fiction.

nodes.label: Head Down
nodes.description: King follows the 1989 season of his son Owen's Little League baseball team. This nonfiction essay records the team's progress towards the Maine state championships, finding drama in the setbacks and achievements of young players.

nodes.label: Brooklyn August
nodes.description: A baseball poem looking back fondly on the professional game's earlier days. Collected in Nightmares & Dreamscapes, it offers a brief change of form from the volume's fiction and longer nonfiction.

nodes.label: Low Men in Yellow Coats
nodes.description: Bobby Garfield befriends an elderly neighbour at the boarding house where he lives with his mother. Reading the newspaper to his new friend and watching for unusual signs around town give his summer an increasingly mysterious shape.

nodes.label: Hearts in Atlantis
nodes.description: Pete Riley begins university in Maine in 1966, with the Vietnam draft making academic success especially important. An absorbing game of Hearts threatens to draw him and his fellow students away from their studies.

nodes.label: Blind Willie
nodes.description: A man makes his living on the streets of New York by pretending to be blind. His familiar arrangements with the police become less secure when he encounters an officer who may not accept them.

nodes.label: Why We're in Vietnam
nodes.description: John ‘Sully’ Sullivan attends the funeral of a fellow Vietnam veteran. The occasion brings memories of the war and people from his past into the present.

nodes.label: Heavenly Shades of Night Are Falling
nodes.description: Bobby Garfield returns to the Broad Street house of his childhood after nearly forty years away. This closing story in Hearts in Atlantis revisits old memories while keeping an unexpected meeting ahead.

nodes.label: Autopsy Room Four
nodes.description: Howard Cottrell wakes in an autopsy room unable to move or speak. As the attendants prepare to examine him, he must somehow make them understand that he is still alive.

nodes.label: The Man in the Black Suit
nodes.description: A disturbing experience from childhood returns in a haunting recollection. The memory of that mysterious encounter shapes this story from Everything’s Eventual.

nodes.label: All That You Love Will Be Carried Away
nodes.description: A man checks into a motel in Lincoln, Nebraska, and takes stock of his life. A temporary room becomes the setting for a search for meaning.

nodes.label: The Death of Jack Hamilton
nodes.description: Outlaws flee pursuit in Depression-era America in this crime story about life on the run.

nodes.label: In the Deathroom
nodes.description: Fletcher is held prisoner in a South American stronghold. His interrogators are prepared to use torture to get the information they want, leaving him to face a desperate struggle in the interrogation room.

nodes.label: The Little Sisters of Eluria
nodes.description: After an ambush in a deserted town, Roland the gunslinger comes under the care of an unusual group of nurses. Their strange infirmary offers little reassurance in this story connected to The Dark Tower.

nodes.label: Everything's Eventual
nodes.description: A nineteen-year-old pizza delivery worker receives an unusual job offer from a mysterious stranger. The promise of something better opens the way to a very different working life.

nodes.label: L.T.'s Theory of Pets
nodes.description: L.T. has a theory about the place of pets in a marriage, especially the Siamese cat his wife left behind when she walked out. A note on the fridge marks the beginning of his account.

nodes.label: The Road Virus Heads North
nodes.description: A disturbing painting catches Richard Kinnell’s attention at a yard sale. The purchase brings him into a tale of unsettling images and the power a picture can hold over its owner.

nodes.label: Lunch at the Gotham Cafe
nodes.description: Steve Davis is struggling with both the end of his marriage and nicotine withdrawal. A visit to a Manhattan restaurant introduces a new horror into an already difficult period of his life.

nodes.label: That Feeling, You Can Only Say What It Is in French
nodes.description: The sensation of having lived through a moment before becomes deeply unsettling in this story of déjà vu.
Ghost-story writer Mike Enslin decides to spend a night in a notoriously haunted New York hotel room. What should provide material for another book becomes a frightening test of his own experience.

nodes.label: Riding the Bullet
nodes.description: College student Alan Parker learns that his mother has suffered a stroke and begins hitchhiking towards her hospital. A stranger’s offer of a ride brings him to an unsettling choice.

nodes.label: Luckey Quarter
nodes.description: Reno chambermaid Darlene is raising two children on a tight income when a guest leaves her a quarter as a tip. The small coin offers a moment to imagine a change in her luck.

nodes.label: Willa
nodes.description: While stranded travellers wait for a replacement train, David Sanderson notices that his fiancée Willa has left the station. His search takes him into a nearby town and an increasingly strange situation.

nodes.label: The Gingerbread Girl
nodes.description: After a devastating loss, Em turns to running and moves to a secluded part of the Florida coast. Her new routine brings her past a neighbour’s driveway and into danger.

nodes.label: Harvey's Dream
nodes.description: At their kitchen table, Harvey tells his wife Janet about a nightmare that woke him during the night. Their familiar Saturday-morning routine begins to feel unsettling as he prepares to explain it.

nodes.label: Rest Stop
nodes.description: Writer John Dykstra stops at a roadside facility on his drive home and hears a woman being abused. Alone outside, he must decide whether and how to intervene.

nodes.label: Stationary Bike
nodes.description: Richard Sefkitz begins exercising on a stationary bicycle and uses maps and a painted road to imagine a journey. His daily rides grow unsettling when he starts to feel that someone is following him.

nodes.label: The Things They Left Behind
nodes.description: Scott Staley lost colleagues in the World Trade Center attacks. Nearly a year later, objects from their office cubicles begin appearing in his apartment, bringing their absence into his everyday life.

nodes.label: Graduation Afternoon
nodes.description: A young woman attends a high-school graduation party at her wealthy boyfriend’s Connecticut home. A celebration of the future provides the setting for an abrupt encounter with a less secure world.

nodes.label: N
nodes.description: Sheila writes to a childhood friend about her psychiatrist brother and a patient identified in his notes only as N. The correspondence opens a disturbing mystery around the patient and those records.

nodes.label: The Cat from Hell
nodes.description: A professional hitman receives an unusual assignment: kill a cat. His wealthy client insists the animal is responsible for several deaths, but the job looks deceptively simple.

nodes.label: The New York Times at Special Bargain Rates
nodes.description: A recently bereaved woman answers a telephone call from her husband. What should be impossible becomes an intimate, unsettling conversation about loss and the fragile connection between two lives.

nodes.label: Mute
nodes.description: A travelling salesman offers a lift to a hitchhiker who says he cannot hear or speak. Believing his passenger cannot understand him, the driver begins to unload his private troubles.

nodes.label: Ayana
nodes.description: A young girl visits a hospital patient who is dying of cancer. Her arrival brings an extraordinary change and draws the patient’s son into a story of miracles and obligation.

nodes.label: A Very Tight Place
nodes.description: Curtis Johnson arrives at an abandoned construction site expecting to settle a legal dispute with his neighbour. The supposed meeting for a resolution becomes a dangerous confrontation.
A Nebraska farmer’s confession opens this rural tale of a marriage, inherited land and a terrible crime. Family tensions and the struggle over the farm shape a story told by the man at its centre.

nodes.label: Big Driver
nodes.description: Mystery writer Tess accepts a book-club speaking engagement and takes a shortcut on her drive home. What should be a routine trip becomes the beginning of a harrowing ordeal.

nodes.label: Fair Extension
nodes.description: A man facing cancer is offered a bargain that promises to change his luck. The offer turns an ordinary roadside encounter into a disturbing question about what someone might pay for a better life.

nodes.label: A Good Marriage
nodes.description: After more than twenty years of marriage, Darcy Anderson finds something unexpected in her husband’s garage. The discovery unsettles the familiar life she thought she understood.

nodes.label: Under the Weather
nodes.description: A short story first offered as an extra in the 2011 US paperback and new ebook edition of Full Dark, No Stars, and later collected in The Bazaar of Bad Dreams. It was absent from the original Full Dark hardcover.

nodes.label: Mr. Harrigan's Phone
nodes.description: A boy hired to read to a retired businessman develops an unlikely friendship with him. A gift of an iPhone introduces a troubling new connection into their lives in this story from If It Bleeds.

nodes.label: The Life of Chuck
nodes.description: Three linked sections trace the life of Charles Krantz in reverse. The narrative moves from his adult years towards childhood, finding meaning in the moments that make up a life.

nodes.label: If It Bleeds
nodes.description: Private investigator Holly Gibney looks into a Pennsylvania school bombing and the television coverage surrounding it. A reporter’s uncanny presence at major tragedies gives her a troubling thread to follow.

nodes.label: Rat
nodes.description: Drew Larson retreats to an old family cabin to finish a novel after earlier attempts have gone badly. Illness, stormy weather and his own doubts turn the writing retreat into something increasingly unsettling.

nodes.label: Two Talented Bastids
nodes.description: Two men’s remarkable talents have an origin they have kept hidden for years. This story explores the secret behind their abilities.

nodes.label: The Fifth Step
nodes.description: A retiree’s quiet morning in Central Park is interrupted by a stranger asking for help. A brief encounter becomes an unsettling conversation.

nodes.label: Willie the Weirdo
nodes.description: Willie’s fascination with dead birds, insects and destruction sets him apart from others. His grandfather shares his unusual interests and tells stories that make their bond increasingly unsettling.

nodes.label: Danny Coughlin's Bad Dream
nodes.description: An unexpected psychic experience sets off upheaval across many lives. A brief flash of knowledge has consequences far beyond the person who experiences it.

nodes.label: Finn
nodes.description: An unlucky young man in Ireland finds himself mistaken for someone else. This darkly comic story follows Finn into a situation where other people’s power can turn an ordinary life upside down.

nodes.label: On Slide Inn Road
nodes.description: A family sets off to visit an elderly relative, only for their car to become stuck in a muddy rut. An ordinary road trip takes an unsettling turn.

nodes.label: Red Screen
nodes.description: A detective questions a plumber who has killed his wife. What begins as an interrogation in a murder case hints at something more disturbing behind the man’s account.

nodes.label: The Turbulence Expert
nodes.description: King’s aviation-horror story first appeared in Flight or Fright in 2018, the anthology he edited with Bev Vincent. It was later collected in You Like It Darker in 2024.

nodes.label: Laurie
nodes.description: After his wife’s death, retired Florida resident Lloyd Sunderland receives a puppy from his concerned sister. The unexpected responsibility brings a new companion into his grieving life.

nodes.label: Rattlesnakes
nodes.description: A grieving widower travels to Florida hoping for a respite. An unexpected inheritance brings troubling conditions in this story, which continues a thread from Cujo.

nodes.label: The Dreamers
nodes.description: A quiet Vietnam veteran responds to a job advertisement. The work leads him towards unsettling possibilities beyond the familiar world.

nodes.label: The Answer Man
nodes.description: Knowing what lies ahead may be a gift or a burden. This story explores foreknowledge, chance and the search for meaning in a life.

nodes.label: Mile 81
nodes.description: A boarded-up rest stop on the Maine Turnpike becomes the meeting point for a boy, passing motorists and a mud-covered station wagon. An apparently abandoned car draws people towards an increasingly unsettling mystery.

nodes.label: Premium Harmony
nodes.description: Ray and Mary Burkett spend much of their marriage arguing. A shopping trip with their dog provides the setting for a close look at the resentments beneath an ordinary couple’s daily life.

nodes.label: Batman and Robin Have an Altercation
nodes.description: Sanderson takes his father, who has Alzheimer’s, to their regular weekly lunch. Their familiar routine brings memories of the man his father used to be into the present.
alternatives: Batman and Robin Have An Altercation

nodes.label: The Dune
nodes.description: Retired judge Harvey Beecher tells his lawyer about a small island and the sand dune he has visited since childhood. What began with a story about buried treasure has become a lifelong fascination.

nodes.label: Bad Little Kid
nodes.description: In prison, George Hallas tells his attorney about a mysterious boy whose appearances have marked his life. His account links those encounters to the loss of people he loved. The story was released in French and German in 2014 before its English appearance in The Bazaar of Bad Dreams in 2015.

nodes.label: A Death
nodes.description: Jim Trusdale is arrested after a young girl is murdered in the Black Hills of Dakota. This late-nineteenth-century crime story begins with suspicion and the question of a man’s guilt.

nodes.label: The Bone Church
nodes.description: This narrative poem follows a jungle expedition into danger. It brings the unsettling atmosphere of King’s fiction into verse.

nodes.label: Morality
nodes.description: Chad and Nora are struggling to make ends meet when Nora’s employer, a retired minister, makes an unusual offer. The promise of financial security confronts them with a difficult moral choice.

nodes.label: Afterlife
nodes.description: Investment banker William Andrews dies and encounters an existence beyond his familiar life. The story follows his confrontation with what comes after death.

nodes.label: UR
nodes.description: After a painful breakup, English instructor Wesley Smith orders an e-reader. The unusual device delivered to him opens a literary world unlike the one he knows.

nodes.label: Herman Wouk Is Still Alive
nodes.description: Two friends take their children on a road trip after a lottery win, while two older poets travel towards a university appearance. The story follows these very different journeys along the same road.

nodes.label: Mister Yummy
nodes.description: Two men in an assisted-living home talk about ageing, memory and an attractive stranger one of them once saw in a nightclub. The long-ago encounter has recently taken on an unsettling new significance.

nodes.label: Tommy
nodes.description: An elegy remembering a classmate and the 1960s. This poem offers a different kind of reflection among the fiction in The Bazaar of Bad Dreams.

nodes.label: Little Green God of Agony
nodes.description: Nurse Kat MacDonald cares for a wealthy man who is still in pain after an airplane crash. When he brings in a healer promising relief, her understanding of his treatment is put to the test.

nodes.label: That Bus Is Another World
nodes.description: On his way to an appointment that could transform his career, a man witnesses something disturbing. Reporting it may mean losing his opportunity; ignoring it presents a different cost.

nodes.label: Obits
nodes.description: An obituary writer discovers that words on a page can have consequences beyond the newsroom. This story from The Bazaar of Bad Dreams turns a familiar newspaper job into a disturbing question about power and responsibility.

nodes.label: Drunken Fireworks
nodes.description: A Maine man recalls an annual fireworks rivalry with a neighbour across the lake. Their friendly summer competition becomes an increasingly extravagant contest.

nodes.label: Summer Thunder
nodes.description: Two men live in the aftermath of an apocalypse, perhaps among the last people left. The story stays close to their lives in a world that has almost fallen silent.

nodes.label: A Face in the Crowd
nodes.description: Widower Dean Evers spends his evenings watching baseball on television until familiar faces begin appearing behind home plate. King and Stewart O'Nan turn a spectator's routine into an unsettling encounter with the people of his past.

media.label: No standalone edition or containing collection registered; no independent cover expected.

nodes.label: Before the Play
nodes.description: Events at the Overlook Hotel before the Torrance family's arrival form the subject of this story. It looks back towards the hotel's earlier history, providing another approach to the setting associated with The Shining.

media.label: No standalone edition or containing collection registered; no independent cover expected.

nodes.label: The Blue Air Compressor
nodes.description: This short story appears in Shining in the Dark, an anthology published in March 2018. The anthology offers a place to find the work alongside fiction by other contributors.

media.label: No standalone edition or containing collection registered; no independent cover expected.

nodes.label: Cookie Jar
nodes.description: A school interview brings thirteen-year-old Dale to visit his great-grandfather Rhett in a retirement home. Instead of describing an ordinary childhood, Rhett turns to memories of his mother and the cookie jar she left behind.

media.label: No standalone edition or containing collection registered; no independent cover expected.

nodes.label: The Crate
nodes.description: A university janitor discovers a mysterious crate, bringing a strange object into the lives of Dexter Stanley and Henry Northrup. The story centres on the discovery and the people whose lives become entangled with it.

media.label: No standalone edition or containing collection registered; no independent cover expected.

nodes.label: Dinah's Hat
nodes.description: Published in The Atlantic's June 2026 issue, this story appeared online on May 15, 2026. It is one of King's magazine contributions outside his principal story collections.

media.label: No standalone edition or containing collection registered; no independent cover expected.

nodes.label: The Extra Hour
nodes.description: Soames notices that Jim Danton's health has deteriorated dramatically since their previous meeting. That disturbing change opens a story published in Cemetery Dance magazine, where the visible signs of exhaustion precede any explanation.

media.label: No standalone edition or containing collection registered; no independent cover expected.

nodes.label: Father's Day
nodes.description: On her way to the Grantham family's annual Father's Day gathering, Bedelia visits her father's grave. A bitter family history shadows the occasion, and a small accident at the cemetery gives the ritual an ominous turn.

media.label: No standalone edition or containing collection registered; no independent cover expected.

nodes.label: The Glass Floor
nodes.description: Charles Wharton wants to see the room where his sister Janine died, but her husband has sealed it and refuses access. A family's bereavement becomes a mystery surrounding the room and its glass floor.

media.label: No standalone edition or containing collection registered; no independent cover expected.

nodes.label: In the Tall Grass
nodes.description: A sister and brother stop beside a field after hearing a child calling for help. Inside the grass they quickly lose their bearings and each other in this collaboration between Stephen King and Joe Hill.

media.label: No EN edition cover registered; another-language edition example is available.

nodes.label: Jumper
nodes.description: An early story King wrote at twelve and self-published in Dave's Rag, the community newspaper he ran with his brother David. It belongs to the youthful writing that preceded his professional career.

nodes.label: The Lonesome Death of Jordy Verrill
nodes.description: A strange meteor lands on Jordy Verrill's farm, drawing him into an encounter with something unfamiliar. The discovery places an ordinary rural life in the path of an extraordinary intrusion.

media.label: No standalone edition or containing collection registered; no independent cover expected.

nodes.label: Man With a Belly
nodes.description: A magazine story published in Cavalier in December 1978 and Gent in November–December 1979. It also appears in the 2017 anthology Killer Crimes, providing another place to find the work.

media.label: No standalone edition or containing collection registered; no independent cover expected.

nodes.label: Memory
nodes.description: First appearing in Tin House and later included as an annex to Blaze, this short piece became the opening of Duma Key. It offers a glimpse of material that developed into a larger novel.

media.label: No standalone edition or containing collection registered; no independent cover expected.

nodes.label: The Music Room
nodes.description: The Enderbys have work during the Great Depression, when employment offers a rare measure of security. This story appears in In Sunlight or in Shadow, an anthology of fiction inspired by Edward Hopper's paintings.

media.label: No standalone edition or containing collection registered; no independent cover expected.

nodes.label: The Night of the Tiger
nodes.description: This short story is included in More Tales of Unknown Horror, an anthology published in 1979. Readers can find it there as one of King's contributions to a volume shared with other writers.

media.label: No standalone edition or containing collection registered; no independent cover expected.

nodes.label: The Old Dude's Ticker
nodes.description: Vietnam veteran Richard Drogan returns with unusually sensitive hearing that makes life with his elderly roommate increasingly difficult. King's story revisits Edgar Allan Poe's The Tell-Tale Heart through a later generation's experience.

media.label: No standalone edition or containing collection registered; no independent cover expected.

nodes.label: The Reploids
nodes.description: Edward Paladin appears on The Tonight Show in Johnny Carson's place. His unexplained arrival disrupts a familiar television setting, turning an ordinary broadcast into a mystery about the man occupying the host's chair.

media.label: No standalone edition or containing collection registered; no independent cover expected.

nodes.label: The Revelations of 'Becka Paulson
nodes.description: A picture of Jesus on top of her television seems to send messages to 'Becka Paulson about her marriage. Domestic unease takes a strange form as an everyday household object becomes the source of supposed revelations.

media.label: No standalone edition or containing collection registered; no independent cover expected.

nodes.label: Rush Call
nodes.description: King wrote this early story at twelve for Dave's Rag, the small newspaper he produced with his brother David. Its later inclusion in Secret Windows places the youthful work alongside his reflections on writing.

media.collectionLabel: Secret Windows: Essays and Fiction on the Craft of Writing
media.label: Placeholder — not official artwork

nodes.label: Something to Tide You Over
nodes.description: A marriage and an affair connect Richard Vickers, his wife and Harry Wentworth. These three characters form the centre of a story whose title offers an ominous suggestion of what may lie ahead.

media.label: No standalone edition or containing collection registered; no independent cover expected.

nodes.label: The Tale of Gray Dick
nodes.description: Published in McSweeney's Mammoth Treasury of Thrilling Tales, this excerpt later appeared in Wolves of the Calla. It provides a shorter route into material connected with King's Dark Tower sequence.

media.label: No standalone edition or containing collection registered; no independent cover expected.

nodes.label: They're Creeping Up on You
nodes.description: Wealthy Upson Pratt detests insects and germs, but bugs in his apartment disturb his carefully controlled surroundings. The situation brings his fear of contamination into the centre of this unsettling tale.

media.label: No standalone edition or containing collection registered; no independent cover expected.

nodes.label: Thin Scenery
nodes.description: Published in the Summer 2017 issue of Ploughshares, this work appears in volume 43, number 2. Its magazine publication offers a place to read it outside King's principal collections.

media.label: No standalone edition or containing collection registered; no independent cover expected.

nodes.label: Throttle
nodes.description: A trucker and a group of outlaw motorcyclists confront one another in the Nevada desert. King and Joe Hill's collaboration takes inspiration from Richard Matheson's Duel, bringing their own characters to a dangerous encounter on the road.

media.label: No EN edition cover registered; another-language edition example is available.

nodes.label: Weeds
nodes.description: Jordy Verrill imagines a windfall when a meteorite lands on his property. His hopes of easy money meet the danger carried by the object in a story collected in Dark Screams: Volume One.

media.label: No standalone edition or containing collection registered; no independent cover expected.

nodes.description: A memoir about becoming a writer and a practical guide to the craft, bringing together King’s personal experience and advice on storytelling.

nodes.label: GUNS
nodes.description: An essay in which King examines gun violence and the debate over gun control in the United States.

nodes.label: Charlie the Choo-Choo
nodes.description: A picture book about engineer Bob and his unusual train, written by Stephen King as Beryl Evans and illustrated by Ned Dameron.

nodes.label: Hansel and Gretel
nodes.description: King retells the classic fairy tale with illustrations by Maurice Sendak, bringing two distinctive imaginations to a familiar journey into the woods.

nodes.label: The Plant: Zenith Rising
nodes.description: An unfinished novel released in installments, centred on a small publishing house and an unexpected delivery.

nodes.label: Storm of the Century
nodes.description: King’s published original screenplay follows an isolated island community as a fierce winter storm approaches.

nodes.label: Ghost Brothers of Darkland County
nodes.description: A stage musical with a book by Stephen King and music and lyrics by John Mellencamp, weaving a ghost story through a roots-inspired score.

nodes.label: Gwendy's Magic Feather
nodes.description: Richard Chizmar returns to Castle Rock with an adult Gwendy Peterson, whose mysterious button box reappears as children vanish from her hometown. The middle novel of the Gwendy trilogy includes a foreword by Stephen King.

nodes.label: You Like It Darker
nodes.description: Twelve stories explore mortality, chance and the uneasy places where ordinary experience gives way to something stranger. The collection includes Danny Coughlin’s Bad Dream, Rattlesnakes and The Answer Man.

nodes.label: Night Shift
nodes.description: An early collection of short fiction that finds danger in ordinary places, from workplaces to small towns. It includes Children of the Corn, Jerusalem’s Lot and The Boogeyman.

nodes.label: Different Seasons
nodes.description: Four novellas explore imprisonment, corruption, childhood and determination: Rita Hayworth and Shawshank Redemption, Apt Pupil, The Body and The Breathing Method. Their varied settings offer four distinct ways into King’s longer short fiction.

nodes.label: Skeleton Crew
nodes.description: This collection brings together works such as The Mist, The Monkey and Gramma. Familiar settings become unsettling as its stories move through technological nightmares, childhood fears and encounters with the unknown.

nodes.label: Four Past Midnight
nodes.description: Four novellas follow unsettling breaks in ordinary reality: “The Langoliers”, “Secret Window, Secret Garden”, “The Library Policeman” and “The Sun Dog”. Journeys, writing, borrowed books and a camera become openings into danger.

nodes.label: Nightmares & Dreamscapes
nodes.description: A wide-ranging collection combines horror stories with detective pastiche, a screenplay, poetry and nonfiction. Its mix includes Dolan’s Cadillac, The Doctor’s Case and the baseball essay Head Down.

nodes.label: Hearts in Atlantis
nodes.description: Five linked narratives follow lives shaped by growing up in the 1960s and by the Vietnam War. Beginning with Low Men in Yellow Coats, the book connects childhood friendships, memory and choices that echo into later life.

nodes.label: Everything's Eventual
nodes.description: Fourteen pieces of short fiction include 1408, Riding the Bullet and the title story. Encounters with the strange sit alongside ordinary anxieties in a collection that ranges across different forms of suspense and horror.

nodes.label: Just After Sunset
nodes.description: Stories such as The Gingerbread Girl and N. turn familiar actions and places towards unease. The collection moves between psychological tension, supernatural possibilities and the uncertain boundary between them.

nodes.label: Stephen King Goes to the Movies
nodes.description: Five works with screen versions are brought together with introductions by King. The selection includes 1408, Children of the Corn and Rita Hayworth and Shawshank Redemption, connecting the original fiction with its life on film.

nodes.label: Full Dark, No Stars
nodes.description: Four longer stories centre on retribution and the compromises people make under pressure: 1922, Big Driver, Fair Extension and A Good Marriage. The paperback release adds Under the Weather to the original group.

nodes.label: The Bazaar of Bad Dreams
nodes.description: Short fiction and poetry are accompanied by King’s notes on how the pieces came to be written or revised. The collection includes Mile 81, UR and Blockade Billy, with recurring questions of mortality, guilt and choices that cannot easily be undone.

nodes.label: If It Bleeds
nodes.description: Four novellas—Mr. Harrigan’s Phone, The Life of Chuck, If It Bleeds and Rat—explore unsettling changes in familiar lives. The collection offers four distinct entry points into King’s longer short fiction.

nodes.label: The Bachman Books
nodes.description: The original omnibus gathers Rage, The Long Walk, Roadwork and The Running Man, four early novels published under King’s Richard Bachman name. Its publication history is affected by King’s later decision to withdraw Rage from reprinting.

nodes.label: Mid-Life Confidential: The Rock Bottom Remainders Tour America With Three Chords and an Attitude
nodes.description: A multi-author account of the Rock Bottom Remainders’ first tour, with writers describing their temporary lives as a rock band. Stephen King contributes alongside the other band members, and photographs by Tabitha King document the trip.
alternatives: Mid-life Confidential: The Rock Bottom Remainders Tour America with Three Chords and an Attitude

nodes.label: Secret Windows: Essays and Fiction on the Craft of Writing
nodes.description: Essays, interviews and fiction about writing are collected alongside early stories and an introduction by Peter Straub. The book offers another perspective on King’s working life and his reflections on the craft.

nodes.label: Flight or Fright
nodes.description: An aviation-horror anthology edited by Stephen King and Bev Vincent, combining classic tales with new contributions from King and Joe Hill. The collection explores the fears that can accompany flying; King’s The Turbulence Expert is one of its stories.

nodes.label: Gwendy-trilogie
nodes.description: A Dutch omnibus bringing together Gwendy’s Button Box, Gwendy’s Magic Feather and Gwendy’s Final Task. Stephen King and Richard Chizmar co-wrote the first and last books; Chizmar wrote the middle novel, with a foreword by King. The three existing works remain separately available to explore.

nodes.label: Holly Gibney
nodes.description: Holly Gibney is a private investigator whose stories begin in the Bill Hodges trilogy. Her later cases continue in the novella If It Bleeds and the novels Holly and Never Flinch.

nodes.label: Danny Torrance
nodes.description: Danny Torrance is the young son of Jack and Wendy in The Shining. His unusual perceptions make the family’s winter at the Overlook Hotel especially unsettling.

nodes.label: Jack Torrance
nodes.description: Jack Torrance is a writer who takes a winter caretaker job at the Overlook Hotel in The Shining, bringing his wife Wendy and their son Danny.

nodes.label: Wendy Torrance
nodes.description: Wendy Torrance moves into the Overlook Hotel with her husband Jack and their young son Danny in The Shining. The isolated winter setting puts their family at the centre of the story.

nodes.label: Abra Stone
nodes.description: Abra Stone is a girl with an extraordinary gift known as the shining. Her path crosses Dan Torrance’s in Doctor Sleep.

nodes.label: Paul Sheldon
nodes.description: Paul Sheldon is the novelist at the centre of Misery. After a car accident, he finds himself in the care of Annie Wilkes, an intensely devoted reader of his books.

nodes.label: Annie Wilkes
nodes.description: Annie Wilkes is a former nurse and devoted reader of Paul Sheldon’s novels. In Misery, she takes the injured writer into her home after his car accident.

nodes.label: Carol Gerber
nodes.description: Carol Gerber is one of Bobby Garfield’s friends in Low Men in Yellow Coats. Her story also crosses Pete Riley’s university life in Hearts in Atlantis.

nodes.label: John “Sully” Sullivan
nodes.description: John “Sully” Sullivan is a friend of Bobby Garfield and Carol Gerber in Low Men in Yellow Coats. He is one of the recurring figures in the Hearts in Atlantis collection.

nodes.label: Bobby Garfield
nodes.description: Bobby Garfield is the boy at the centre of Low Men in Yellow Coats. He lives with his mother in a boarding house, where a new neighbour gives the summer a mysterious turn.

nodes.label: Red
nodes.description: Red is a prisoner at Shawshank who can obtain things for a price. His place in the prison community forms part of Rita Hayworth and Shawshank Redemption.

nodes.label: Carrie White
nodes.description: A high-school student who discovers she has telekinetic abilities. Carrie’s isolation at school and difficult life with her religious mother form the opening situation of King’s first published novel.

nodes.label: Johnny Smith
nodes.description: A former schoolteacher who wakes from a coma with the ability to perceive other people’s pasts and futures through touch. His story in The Dead Zone asks what a person should do with knowledge they never wanted.

nodes.label: Ben Mears
nodes.description: An author returning to his childhood hometown to write about a house that has haunted him for years. Ben Mears provides a way into the community at the centre of ’Salem’s Lot.

nodes.label: John Coffey
nodes.description: A gentle prisoner whose arrival on Cold Mountain’s death row unsettles the routines of its guards. John Coffey stands at the centre of The Green Mile’s questions about judgement and compassion.

nodes.label: Paul Edgecombe
nodes.description: The superintendent of E Block at Cold Mountain Penitentiary and narrator of The Green Mile. His work places him among the prisoners and guards whose everyday routines are disrupted by John Coffey’s arrival.

nodes.label: Bill Denbrough
nodes.description: One of IT’s seven childhood friends; he becomes a writer.

nodes.label: Ben Hanscom
nodes.description: One of Derry’s childhood friends, later an architect.

nodes.label: Beverly Marsh
nodes.description: A member of the Derry group, later a dress designer.

nodes.label: Mike Hanlon
nodes.description: The childhood friend who calls the group back to Derry.

nodes.label: Richie Tozier
nodes.description: A member of the group whose adult career is in radio.

nodes.label: Eddie Kaspbrak
nodes.description: One of Derry’s childhood friends, introduced with severe asthma.

nodes.label: Stanley Uris
nodes.description: One of IT’s childhood friends, introduced as an accountant in adulthood.

nodes.label: Charlie McGee
nodes.description: A girl whose ability to start fires draws the attention of a government agency. Firestarter follows the danger facing Charlie and her family.

nodes.label: Andy McGee
nodes.description: Charlie McGee’s father. He tries to protect his daughter from the agency interested in her unusual ability.

nodes.label: Louis Creed
nodes.description: A doctor who moves from Chicago to rural Maine with his family. His new home stands near a busy road and a children’s pet cemetery.

nodes.label: Rachel Creed
nodes.description: Louis Creed’s wife, who moves with their family from Chicago to rural Maine. She belongs to the family at the centre of Pet Sematary.

nodes.label: Cujo
nodes.description: The Camber family’s Saint Bernard, once a friendly companion. His dangerous change is the central threat in Cujo.

nodes.label: Donna Trenton
nodes.description: A Castle Rock mother whose car trouble leads to a terrifying encounter with Cujo. She and her son Tad are central to the novel.

nodes.label: Vic Trenton
nodes.description: An advertising professional, Donna’s husband and Tad’s father. Business pressures take him away from his family during the novel’s opening situation.

nodes.label: Tad Trenton
nodes.description: Donna and Vic Trenton’s young son. A trip with his mother becomes part of the novel’s dangerous encounter with Cujo.

nodes.label: Bill Hodges
nodes.description: A retired police detective at the centre of Mr. Mercedes, Finders Keepers and End of Watch. His investigations bring him together with Holly Gibney and Jerome Robinson.

nodes.label: Jerome Robinson
nodes.description: A friend and collaborator of Bill Hodges, part of the central trio introduced in Mr. Mercedes and continued in the two sequels.

nodes.label: Mid-World
nodes.description: Explore the settings and mentions of Mid-World.

nodes.label: Derry
nodes.description: Derry is a recurring fictional Maine city. It and Insomnia explore its streets, Dreamcatcher recalls childhood there, and Bag of Bones opens with Mike Noonan’s life in the city.

nodes.label: Castle Rock
nodes.description: Castle Rock is a fictional town in Maine that provides a recurring home for King’s characters. Its stories range from the everyday streets of Cujo and Needful Things to the unusual experiences of Gwendy Peterson and the quiet mystery of Elevation.

nodes.label: Overlook Hotel
nodes.description: The Overlook Hotel is the remote winter setting of The Shining. Jack Torrance becomes its caretaker while staying there with Wendy and Danny, cut off from the outside world.

nodes.label: Shawshank Prison
nodes.description: Shawshank Prison is the setting of Rita Hayworth and Shawshank Redemption. Its inmates and guards form the community at the centre of the novella.

nodes.label: Cold Mountain Penitentiary
nodes.description: The prison whose E Block is known as the Green Mile. Its death-row prisoners and guards form the community at the centre of King’s serial novel.

nodes.label: Gilead
nodes.description: Roland’s home city in the Barony of New Canaan. Gilead belongs to the background and traditions of the gunslinger’s world; its history can be discovered through The Dark Tower books.
